results.name: Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current
results.title: Parcel Boundaries of Indiana Current
results.description: This data layer is an Esri file geodatabase polygon feature class that contains parcel boundaries maintained by county agencies in Indiana. It was released by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO) on February 1, 2022. The IGIO compiled the data as part of the Indiana Data Harvest program between the Indiana Geographic Information Council (IGIC) and all Indiana counties to provide the most accurate framework data for the citizens of Indiana. These layers include address points, street centerlines, land parcels, and governmental boundaries.
results.snippet:
This dataset was developed to provide accurate parcel boundaries for Indiana, as part of Indiana's annual GIS Data harvest Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI) of the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IGIO).

If attempting to download this data in shapefile or file geodatabase format on indianamap.org, please note that this dataset is too large to fit in a shapefile and generating a geodatabase does not perform well in the ArcGIS Hub interface. To download a pre-zipped file geodatabase, please go to https://countydataharvest.in.gov/statewide/2022/DataHarvest_2022_SingleFGDB_20230125.zip.
results.accessInformation: This data set was created as part of the Indiana Geographic Information Office's GIS Data Harvest Program. The source data used to create this dataset was provided by Indiana counties.

results.name: Tax_Parcels_Ver_2_Parcels_Only
results.title: Tax Parcels - Whiteside County
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides detailed tax parcel information for Whiteside County, Illinois. It represents parcel-level geographic and property data essential for tax assessment, planning, and property management.

Feature Layer
  • Tax Parcels: This layer includes comprehensive tax parcel data such as parcel identification numbers, property class and usage, owner information, site and postal addresses, assessed and taxable values, tax district and school district details, property descriptions, building and land characteristics, and tax payment status. It covers essential attributes to support tax administration and land management.
Geographic Coverage

The data covers the jurisdiction of Whiteside County in the state of Illinois, providing localized and precise parcel information.

Use Cases
  • Property tax assessment and collection
  • Land use planning and zoning review
  • Real estate and property ownership research
  • Infrastructure and utility service planning
  • Legal and governmental record keeping
results.snippet: Detailed parcel-level tax and property data for Whiteside County, Illinois, supporting tax assessment and land management.

results.name: Tax_Parcel_Sales_Only_v2
results.title: Tax Parcel Sales - Whiteside County
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides detailed records on tax parcel sales within Whiteside County, Illinois. It is designed to support property and real estate analysis by integrating transactional and assessment data linked to land parcels.

Feature Layer: TaxParcelSale

The TaxParcelSale layer contains comprehensive data on individual parcel sales, including the unique parcel identification number and site address. It records transaction details such as sale amount, transaction dates, document references, and sales ratio.

This layer is valuable for assessing property market trends, aiding in taxation processes, and supporting urban planning and development initiatives. It serves government agencies, real estate professionals, and researchers requiring detailed parcel transaction history and assessed property characteristics.

Geographic Coverage

Data coverage is specific to Whiteside County in the state of Illinois, providing localized insights for this governmental jurisdiction.

Use Cases

  • Real estate market analysis and property valuation studies.
  • Governmental tax assessment and tracking of property ownership transfers.
  • Urban planning and development management using detailed structural and sale data.
  • Legal and historical research concerning property transactions and ownership.
results.snippet: This service features detailed tax parcel sales data, including transaction and property assessment information for parcels in Whiteside County, Illinois.

results.title: 2626_baltimore_ave
results.description:
CountyParcels_DLGF_RESTRICTED is an enhanced version of County Parcel data collected from each of the 92 counties in Indiana as part of the Indiana Data Sharing Initiative (IDSI). These data include the parcel features and attributes from assessment data provided to the Department of Local Government and Finance. Please note, there may be records with duplicate parcel IDs. That will result in the DLGF information being duplicated for each record. The owner, class code, etc. will still be correct, but the value and deeded acreage fields will be for the sum of the matched numbers, not the individual polygons. IMPORTANT: All records in this dataset are completely replaced with each update. Therefore, using the "Create Layer from Selected Features" in ArcMap will not work correctly after the proceeding update, nor will definition queries based on OBJECTID.

Latest update: 11/7/2019 with 2019 polygons (GIO.COUNTY_Parcel) and 2018 pay 2019 DLGF information.
results.snippet:

Therefore, using the "Create Layer from Selected Features" in ArcMap will not work correctly after the proceeding update, nor will definition queries based on OBJECTID.

Latest update: 11/7/2019 with 2019 polygons (GIO.COUNTY_Parcel) and 2018 pay 2019 DLGF information.

results.name: TaxParcelHistoricOnly
results.title: Historic Tax Parcels - Whiteside County
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides historical tax parcel data capturing property characteristics within a defined geographic area. It serves as a resource for analyzing changes in property ownership over time.

Feature Layers

  • TaxParcelHistoric: This layer displays historical tax parcels, including information on parcel identification. Data fields include legal dates marking the historical status.

Geographic Coverage

The dataset specifically covers historic tax parcels within Whiteside County, Illinois, and serves as an authoritative source for retired tax parcels in this jurisdiction.

Use Cases

  • Property tax assessment and valuation trend analysis.
  • Historical ownership and parcel boundary investigations.
  • Supporting municipal planning, real estate research, and legal documentation related to property rights and tax status.
results.snippet: Historic tax parcel information including property indentification and legal end date.

results.name: Tax_Parcel_Foreclosures_Only
results.title: Tax Parcel Foreclosures - Whiteside County
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides detailed information about tax parcel foreclosures within Whiteside County, Illinois. It includes a comprehensive feature layer that documents foreclosure sales and related property records for tax parcels in the area.

Feature Layer

  • TaxParcelForeclosure: This layer represents properties that have undergone tax foreclosure proceedings. It includes critical details such as parcel identification numbers, and site addresses associated with the foreclosure transactions. Key transaction dates and recorded sale amounts are also included, providing insight into the foreclosure process and property disposition.

Geographic Coverage

The dataset specifically covers tax parcels within Whiteside County, Illinois, and serves as an authoritative source for foreclosure data in this jurisdiction.

Applications

  • Supports government agencies and legal entities in tracking foreclosure transactions.
  • Assists real estate professionals and investors in identifying properties that have undergone foreclosure sales.
  • Facilitates analysis related to tax collection, property ownership changes, and county revenue.
results.snippet: This service provides detailed records of tax parcel foreclosures in Whiteside County, Illinois, including property, transaction, and sale information.

results.name: Whiteside_County_Boundary
results.title: Whiteside County Boundary
results.description:
Overview

This feature service provides a polygon boundary for Whiteside County, Illinois. It supports county-level reference, visualization, and spatial analysis within local and regional GIS workflows.

Layer Content

  • Whiteside County Boundary: A boundary layer representing the county extent, with associated attributes such as county name, county area, state and country information, and source details.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Whiteside County in Illinois, United States.

Use Cases

  • County boundary display in web and desktop maps
  • Spatial reference for parcel, planning, and administrative workflows
  • Location-based analysis and reporting at the county scale
results.snippet: County boundary layer for Whiteside County, Illinois, supporting mapping and county-level spatial reference.
